# Coverage of next

This is the coverage of math2 for each MSC2020 class, at the levels of spec 18.1. Each class has a page with its areas.

Documents is the count of the documents of the source zbmath on 2026-10-26, and Counted is the records of the same source. C0 is Counted divided by Documents. Records is the records of all sources. C0 and C1 have a value only for a class with a count. C2 to C4 need the cores of spec 18.3, which are not written yet. A dash means that the level has no value.

| Code | Area | Records | Counted | Documents | C0 | C1 | C2 | C3 | C4 | Nodes | E2 | E5 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| [11-XX](next/11.md) | number theory | 3 | 2 | 4 | 50.0% | 0.0% | - | - | - | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| [20-XX](next/20.md) | groups and their generalizations | 2 | 2 | 1 | 100.0% | 0.0% | - | - | - | 1 | 0 | 0 |
